midHold: Ease off a little if it feels sharp.

reps.perSideStart: {n} on each side. Start with your {side}.
reps.rule: Speak every number for sets of 10 or fewer. Above 10, speak every second number and always the last. The last rep is spoken as lastRep in place of its number.

welcome.flow: Welcome. This is {name}, about {minutes} minutes. Move gently and stop anything that hurts.
welcome.routine: Welcome. This is {name}, about {minutes} minutes. We warm up first. Stop anything that hurts.
welcome.walk: Off we go. Start easy for the first two minutes.
welcome.landmark: Here we are. This one takes about {minutes} minutes. Start easy.

closing.flow: That's the flow. Take one more slow breath. Nicely done.
closing.routine: That's the routine. Nicely done. Have some water.
closing.walk: That's your walk. Ease down for the last two minutes.
closing.landmark: That's the challenge. Nicely done. Walk home easy.

waterAndRest: That's thirty minutes. Have some water and a rest before any more.
